newsitem.title: USA: Matrix Capital to buy Vintage Group.
newsitem.headline: Matrix Capital to buy Vintage Group.

text.p: Matrix Capital Corp said on Monday that it has entered into a letter of intent to buy The Vintage Group for about $11.25 million in newly-issued common stock.
Vintage Group was comprised of two units, Sterling Trust Co and NASD broker dealer Vintage Financial Services Corp.

Sterling Trust is a non-bank trust company in Texas, specializing in self-directed qualified retirement plans, individual retirement accounts, custodial and directed trust accounts. As of June 30, Sterling had assets under administration of over $1 billion, Matrix said.
The transaction would be accounted for as a pooling of interests and Matrix said no goodwill would be recorded.
